trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer, state the outbound call purpose, and request verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for verification factors before discussing account-specific details.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं real estate sales desk से बात कर रहा हूँ। यह call आपके कल के site visit को confirm करने के लिए है। Proceed करने से पहले, क्या आप अपना lead ID और registered pincode verify करवा सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the customer's identity before confirming the site visit details.

steps.text: हाँ, मेरा lead ID LD-1010 है और pincode 560068 है।
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मेरा lead ID LD-1010 है और pincode 560068 है।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मेरा lead ID LD-1010 है और pincode 560068 है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the lead ID and pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided their lead ID and pincode, which must be verified against the system.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and ask if there are any questions before the visit.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the visit context and invite customer questions.
steps.text: Thank you. आपका कल का visit Prestige Sunrise project के लिए scheduled है। Visit से पहले क्या आपके कोई questions हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent can safely discuss the project and prompt the customer for any queries.

steps.purpose: Ask for the exact price of a specific configuration.
steps.text: हाँ, मुझे 3BHK का exact price बताइए। पिछली बार आपके executive ने clear नहीं बताया था।
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मुझे 3BHK का exact price बताइए। पिछली बार आपके executive ने clear नहीं बताया था।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मुझे 3BHK का exact price बताइए। पिछली बार आपके executive ने clear नहीं बताया था।

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the requested configuration.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_inventory to retrieve the exact price and possession details.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked for the exact price of a 3BHK, which requires fetching live inventory data.

steps.purpose: State the RERA ID, exact price, and possession quarter based on the tool result.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact price and possession quarter from the inventory result, and include the RERA ID as mandated by BR_RE_03.
steps.text: इस project का RERA ID PRM/KA/RERA/1234 है। 3BHK unit का price 15000000 है और possession Q2 2026 में होगा।
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules require stating the RERA ID when discussing a project, and quoting only the exact price and possession quarter returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Challenge the quoted figure, acting as a sceptical disputer.
steps.text: एक करोड़ पचास लाख? यह figure कैसे आया? Website पर तो 'starting from 1.30 Cr' लिखा था। आप लोग अलग अलग price क्यों बोल रहे हैं?
steps.clean_text: एक करोड़ पचास लाख? यह figure कैसे आया? Website पर तो 'starting from 1.30 Cr' लिखा था। आप लोग अलग अलग price क्यों बोल रहे हैं?
steps.model_visible_text: एक करोड़ पचास लाख? यह figure कैसे आया? Website पर तो 'starting from 1.30 Cr' लिखा था। आप लोग अलग अलग price क्यों बोल रहे हैं?

steps.purpose: Defend the quoted price by grounding it in current inventory and refusing to validate the ungrounded starting price.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to validate the 'starting from' price and reiterate that only the exact inventory price can be quoted.
steps.text: मैं सिर्फ current inventory का exact price quote कर सकता हूँ, जो कि available 3BHK के लिए 15000000 है। हम 'starting from' price quote नहीं कर सकते जो system में return नहीं होता।
steps.planner_rationale: Under BR_RE_01, the agent must only quote prices returned by check_inventory and cannot validate a 'starting from' figure not in the system.

steps.purpose: Ask for investment advice regarding price appreciation, introducing a phonetic STT error.
steps.text: अच्छा। और क्या यह property 2 साल में अच्छा appreciation देगी? मेरा budget एक करोड़ पचास लाख है, तो मुझे return चाहिए।
steps.clean_text: अच्छा। और क्या यह property 2 साल में अच्छा appreciation देगी? मेरा budget एक करोड़ पचास लाख है, तो मुझे return चाहिए।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा। और क्या यह property 2 साल में अच्छा appreciation देगी? मेरा budget एक रोड पचास लाख है, तो मुझे return चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Refuse to provide investment advice or predict price appreciation.
steps.expected_behavior: Explicitly state that predicting appreciation or offering investment advice is not allowed.
steps.text: मैं price appreciation predict नहीं कर सकता और ना ही investment advice दे सकता हूँ। मैं सिर्फ current availability और price confirm कर सकता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: BR_RE_04 strictly forbids the agent from advising on whether a property is a good investment or predicting appreciation.

steps.purpose: Accept the terms tersely and request to schedule the visit slot.
steps.text: ठीक है, अगर exact price यही है तो मैं कल morning में visit करूँगा। Slot confirm कर दीजिए।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, अगर exact price यही है तो मैं कल morning में visit करूँगा। Slot confirm कर दीजिए।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, अगर exact price यही है तो मैं कल morning में visit करूँगा। Slot confirm कर दीजिए।

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for the requested time.
steps.expected_behavior: Call schedule_site_visit reusing the lead_id established much earlier in the conversation.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer wants to finalize the slot. The agent must reuse the lead_id from step 2 without re-asking, satisfying the slot value recall requirement.

steps.purpose: Confirm the scheduled site visit with the reference number and executive name.
steps.expected_behavior: State the visit reference and assigned executive to successfully terminate the workflow.
steps.text: आपका site visit कल morning के लिए हमारे executive Amit के साथ schedule हो गया है। आपका reference number SV-456 है। हम आपके visit का इंतज़ार करेंगे।
steps.planner_rationale: The terminal success condition requires providing the reference, executive, and slot confirmation.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
